name: cove-tarot-companion
title_zh: 把塔罗牌阵变成一场本地私密对话
tagline_zh: 不联网、不开摄像头，在本地浏览器里完成抽牌与解牌。适合深夜独处或不想被算法记录的时刻，牌意由你与AI共同解读。
tagline_en: Draw and discuss tarot locally, no cloud, no tracking. Perfect for late-night introspection when you want the.
desc_en: Use when a user wants a local Tarot Ritual, returns from one to discuss its original reading, or a companion conversation offers a suitable moment to invite them. Requires an existing local shell and browser; not for independently drawing or reinterpreting cards.
why_zh: 它不替你抽牌，而是把牌阵呈现在本地，让对话自然引出解读。机制上尊重仪式感，拒绝云端黑箱。
why_en: It doesn't draw for you — it stages the spread locally and lets conversation surface the reading. Ritual stays intact, no cloud.
